architecture: v0.4.4 core renderer plus additive v45-v51 enhancements; v51 centers the current active leg and shows adjacent historical legs for context.
hero_readability: Break market summary into readable sentence lines; keep key evaluation/action compact and avoid duplicated dense prose.

cycle.title: 실제 사이클 비교
cycle.current_leg_rule: If current direction is low-to-high, compare that active rise/rebound leg. If current direction is high-to-low, compare that active decline leg.
cycle.context_rule: Historical comparison must also show one immediately preceding leg and one immediately following leg so the active leg is understood inside its surrounding regime.
cycle.historical_path_rule: Keep actual trading-day spacing and actual return path; do not normalize/stretch historical paths to 0-100.
cycle.alignment_rule: Only align the start anchor of the active comparison leg; do not time-stretch or amplitude-stretch historical paths.
cycle.elapsed_rule: Show current N trading days, start-to-current dates and current move directly below the graph.
cycle.pair_rule: Each lower #1/#2/#3 comparison chart contains exactly two lines: current + that single historical path.
cycle.font_rule: Graph axis/pivot/current labels are roughly 2x the previous size for mobile readability.
cycle.forecast_rule: Historical post-match path is descriptive history, never a future high/low date forecast.

android_back_contract: modal open -> hardware Back closes modal
hourly_automation_rule: Update market JSON only; never rewrite HTML/JS/CSS/VERSION or cycle datasets. Keep prose compact and conditional, not commanding.
apk_done_definition: Desktop/mobile Browser QA success -> Android Actions success -> artifact exists -> APK downloaded and integrity checked -> provide APK directly to user
